recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-90s pop-inspired portrait featuring a woman in a crouching pose against a warm, amber-toned interior. The image uses soft-focus photography with a high-contrast serif title overlaying the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head resting on hand
Warm amber background contrasting with dark clothing
Large-scale white typography anchored to the top margin
Soft, diffused lighting creating a nostalgic, hazy atmosphere
coreInvariants: Monochromatic dark outfit (black knit top and skirt)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, full body visible in a crouched position, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text, moves down to the face, follows the arm down to the legs, and rests on the warm floor reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced amber space to the left and right of the subject's torso.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and ochre (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in warm tones with deep, crushed blacks and bright, blown-out highlights in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and brand clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical serif structure and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus photograph of a woman with dark hair, wearing a black knit top and skirt, crouching in a warm amber-lit room. The lighting should be golden and diffused, with a slight film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of all-caps text at the top center using a bold, high-contrast serif font in pure white with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text pure white and centered at the top?
Does the background maintain a warm, golden-amber hue?
Is the subject in a crouching pose with a soft-focus finish?
Is the font a classical serif with high stroke contrast?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black clothing has deep values without losing all texture.
Check that the white text is legible against the background and hair.
Verify the crouching pose feels natural and centered.
Confirm the overall mood is nostalgic and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned, soft-focus portrait in a crouching pose with a top-aligned, high-contrast white serif title in all-caps.
